# Chains of runnables LangChain is a library for composing language-model work as a chain of named runnables. The usual pipe is retrieve, fill a prompt template, invoke a model, then parse the text into a structure. The value of a chain is that each hop is a small object you can swap. # Local models and privacy A local model such as one served by Ollama runs on the same machine as the app. The prompt does not need to leave the computer. That is different from a hosted API, where the text travels to a vendor. Privacy is still a design choice. A local app can log prompts, write uploads to disk, or send analytics. This playground does none of those. Servers bind to localhost. Sessions live in memory
